build_skill_md: build a markdown skill document from the hf CLI app commands and options for AI assistants
create_skills_add: create a CLI command to install Hugging Face marketplace skills into agent directories
run_skills_list: run a CLI command to list available Hugging Face marketplace skills and their install status
run_skills_preview: run a CLI command to print the generated hf-cli SKILL.md content to stdout
run_skills_update: run a CLI command to update installed Hugging Face marketplace skills in specified directories
